concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-reports-and-fees-statement-report]] — 2026-09-15 Payout Service daily Balance Platform Statement Report reference for opening/closing balances, activity, separate pending Transfer/completed Transaction IDs and booking/value dates; zero-to-zero balance accounts are omitted.
warnings: The page calls the report a view of all daily balance changes but explicitly omits accounts opening and ending at zero; do not claim complete activity for such accounts.
Amount/start/end fields are typed Alpha text and timezone columns are described, but this page does not supply a sign, unit or cutoff-timezone rule; report rows are not bank receipt proof.
